close_reason: Expanded BackendChangesError::TooManyChanges doc to explain limit=0 = cannotCalculateChanges = full state reset required by client per RFC 8620 §5.6.
description: jmapio/jmap-js (spec authors) implements cannotCalculateChanges as a FULL state reset: marks ALL local records OBSOLETE, resets state to empty string, triggers full resync. This is not partial recovery. Our BackendChangesError::CannotCalculateChanges maps to JMAP 'cannotCalculateChanges' error, but neither the error type nor the MailBackend/ChatBackend trait doc explains what clients MUST do. Add a doc comment to BackendChangesError::CannotCalculateChanges explaining the required client behavior. Source: ~/GIT/jmap-js/source/mail/mail-model.js.
title: jmap-server: document cannotCalculateChanges full-state-reset behavior
